title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian reveals Karthikeyan's wedding wish for Arasi to the family. Later, Gomathi seeks Arasi's happiness as Senthil shares his work concerns with Meena.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran reaches the venue just in time to stop Chandayatha's wedding. Despite his objections, her father insists on proceeding, but she stuns everyone by revealing her pregnancy.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi and Meena struggle to manage the situation when Nachiyar visits their room. Later, her stay in Muthu's room separates Muthu and Ravi from their wives.

title: Neeya Naana
episodeTitle: A Look at Different Sides of Life
description: Gopinath presents an open-ended episode on life's varied experiences. Participants share their fears, hardships, personal traits, helpless moments, and sources of happiness.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The little stars enchant the stage with soulful devotional songs, vividly bringing the Gods' presence alive. Tune in to witness the divine glory of the Aadi Thiruvizha round.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The cooking battle takes an emotional turn as contestants prepare special dishes for their mothers. Tears overflow as they lovingly feed them, expressing their deep gratitude.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Kuraishi hosts the Thaai Maaman team on a game show filled with image clues and cash prizes. Watch as players tackle challenges to earn Golden Hearts and race to the finish line.
